description: Implementation of the ObsService interface, handling creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of Obs (Observation) objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. Contains methods for managing complex observations, searching, and accessing observation data.

classes.name: ObsServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the ObsService defining methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting observation records, including handling complex data types and querying observations.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves an Obs object, handling new, existing, or voided observations with privilege checks and complex data handling.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an Obs by ID, with specialized handling for complex observations.

methods.name: voidObs
methods.description: Voids an observation, marking it as voided in the database.

methods.name: unvoidObs
methods.description: Unvoids an observation, restoring it to active status.

methods.name: purgeObs
methods.description: Permanently deletes an Obs from the database, including complex data cleanup.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches observations based on various filters such as person, encounter, concept, date range, etc.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of observations matching given criteria.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Obs by its UUID, with handling for complex data types.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Fetches a previous revision of a given Obs.

methods.name: getComplexObs
methods.description: Retrieves a complex observation with specified view.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the ComplexObsHandler responsible for a given Obs.

methods.name: setHandlers
methods.description: Sets multiple handlers for complex Obs, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Returns the current map of registered ComplexObsHandlers.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a new ComplexObsHandler with a string key.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a new ComplexObsHandler from class name.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Removes a registered handler by key.
